scripts.install:ubuntu: apt-get install nodejs nodejs-legacy npm -y; ln -s /usr/bin/nodejs /usr/bin/node; npm -g install coffee-script -y
scripts.install:centos: yum install nodejs npm tmux -y; npm -g install coffee-script -y
scripts.install:create_cert: echo \"'Common Name (e.g. server FQDN or YOUR name)' - your domain name. Password - empty.\"; cd ssl && openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 10000 -newkey rsa:1024 -keyout cert.key -out cert.crt && cd ..
scripts.run: while true; do timeout 24h node index >> logs/`date \"+%Y.%m.%d\"`.log 2>> logs/`date \"+%Y.%m.%d\"`.err; done
